name: Christophe Gomart - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on European Defence Readiness 2030: assessment of needs
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report is the European Parliament's opinion, not a new law. It says Europe has underinvested in defence for decades and needs to spend much more, together rather than country by country. It asks member states to plan their military spending clearly up to 2030, to buy more equipment jointly and to favour European-made products. It also asks the European Investment Bank to lend more to defence companies, including small ones, and asks the Commission to make it easier for private investors to put money into defence.

**Key points**

- Member states should publish spending plans to 2030 and buy at least 40% of equipment jointly.
- The European Investment Bank should widen lending to defence firms, including small suppliers.
- Parliament wants clearer rules so banks and funds stop shunning defence investment.
